recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一顆體積極大的巨核細胞，單一大核高度分葉、染色質粗，細胞質豐富且顆粒細緻，細胞質內可見紅血球（emperipolesis），尺寸遠大於一般成熟巨核細胞，屬巨大巨核細胞（giant megakaryocyte）。
features: Giant megakaryocyte occupying most of the field, far larger than surrounding precursors
Low N:C ratio with a large, deeply lobulated, hyperlobated nucleus with contiguous lobes
Abundant finely granular lilac cytoplasm with a paler peripheral zone
Red cells within the cytoplasm, consistent with emperipolesis
Surrounding maturing granulocytic and erythroid precursors
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a giant megakaryocyte with a large hyperlobated nucleus with coarse chromatin and abundant finely granular cytoplasm. Red cells are present within the cytoplasm, consistent with emperipolesis. The surrounding marrow shows maturing granulocytic and erythroid precursors. A single giant megakaryocyte is not diagnostic; findings may be seen in reactive thrombopoiesis but, when numerous or clustered, are suggestive of a myeloproliferative neoplasm such as essential thrombocythemia, and should be correlated with the biopsy, blood counts and JAK2/CALR/MPL testing.

ddx.vs: ET shows many giant megakaryocytes with hyperlobated staghorn nuclei in loose clusters on the biopsy with sustained thrombocytosis and a driver mutation.
PMF megakaryocytes are pleomorphic with hyperchromatic, bulbous cloud-like nuclei and abnormal N:C ratio, forming tight clusters with fibrosis.
Osteoclasts contain many separate uniform round nuclei rather than a single hyperlobated nucleus.
CML megakaryocytes are small and hypolobated (dwarf megakaryocytes), not giant hyperlobated forms.
